DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 104 s. 2021 August 20, 2021 HON. ANTONINO A. AURELIO, DPA Municipal Vice Mayor 2nd Floor, New Municipal Bldg Brgy. Pauli, Rizal, Laguna Dear Vice Mayor Aurelio: This in reference to your letter dated 25 January 2021, seeking this Department's regarding the following, and we quote: I. Does the Sangguniang Bayan has the right to pend or prevent the assumption of the Vice President of the Pederasyon ng Kabataan as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan? 2. To which instances can the Pederasyon ng Kabataan conduct a re-election of officers and elect from themselves a new Pederasyon President? Contextually, an administrative case was filed against SK Chairperson Kemp M. Villanueva, before the Sangguniang Bayan (SB) of Rizal, Laguna, docketed as Administrative Case No. 01-2020. In a decision dated 15 January 2021, SB Rizal found SK Villanueva guilty for violation of Section 18(f) and (h) of Republic Act No. 10742, thereby imposing upon him the penalty of removal from office with accessory penalties. Despite the SK's awareness and knowledge regarding DILG-COMELEC-NYC Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2017-1 , they nonetheless seeks guidance from this Department regarding the above- mentioned queries. With respect to issue no. I , we answer in the negative. Pursuant to Section 22(a) of Republic Act (RA) No. 10742, otherwise known as the "Sangguniang Kabataan Reform Act of 2015, in relation to Section 41 (b) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC) the duly elected president of the Pederasyon ng Sangguniang Kabataan shall serve as ex officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan. Further, Section 41 (a)(l) and (3) of DILG-COMELEC-NYC Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2017-1 states that in case of permanent vacancy in the Office of the Pederasyon President, the Pederasyon Vice President shall automatically assume the office for the unexpired portion of the term, and shall enjoy the rights and privileges appurtenant to the office including representation in the local sanggunian. Thus, applying the facts at hand, we see no reason for the Sanggunian to prevent the assumption of the SK Pederasyon Vice President as an ex-officio member of the sanggunian. The law expressly states that the assumption in office of the Pederasyon Vice President is automatic, thus, does not require any condition and/or requirements for the said purpose. Otherwise, the same might hamper the govemment service, especially in the youth sector. On issue no. 2, we likewise answer in the negative. The only instance where the Pederasyon ng Kabataan can conduct election of its officers is provided in Section 3 of DILG-COMELEC-NYC Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2017-1. In connection thereto, should there be any vacancy in office, temporary or otherwise, Sections 41 and 42 of the said JMC shall govern. The pertinent provision state: "SECTION 41. FILLINF UP OF VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF THE PEDERASYON PRESIDENT a. b. PERMANENT VACANCY- In case the Pederasyon President voluntarily resigns, dies, is permanently incapacitated, is removed from office, or has been absent without leave for more than three consecutive months, the Vice President of the concerned Pederasyon shall: I. Automatically assume the office for the unexpired portion of the term; 2. Discharge the powers and duties of the pederasyon president; 3. Enjoy the rights and privileges appurtenant to the office including representation in the local sanggunian and the receipt of the corresponding monetary remuneration for the services concerned; and 4. Special election shall be held to elect the Vice President of the Pederasyon from among the other officers of the Pederasyon. TEMPORARY VACANCY- In case the Pederasyon President is suspended as a result of an administrative case or has taken any form of authorized leave of absence either as a Pederasyon President or an ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Panlungsod/Bayan or Panlalawigan for more than one month, the Vice President of the Pederasyon shall: I. Automatically assume the office of the concemed Pederasyon President in an until such time that the concerned Pederasyon President reassumes his/her office; Page 2 of 3

2. 3. 4. SECTION Discharge the powers and duties of the pederasyon president; Enjoy the rights and privileges appurtenant to the office including representation in the local sanggunian; and Entitled to the corresponding monetary remuneration for the services concerned. 42. FILLING UP OF PERMANENT ORR TEMPORARY VACANCY IN OTHER POSITIONS/OFFICE OF THE PEDERASYON-Vacancies in other positions shall be filled up through an appointment by the Pederasyon President upon concurrence of the majority of all the Pederasyon officers." Clearly, based on the foregoing, there is/are no instance/s where re-election of officers can be had. The manner and process of filling-up vacancies should be in accordance with RA 10742 in relation to DILG-COMELEC-NYC Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2017-1. Finally, may we note that for an SK Pederasyon President may be removed from office, the grounds thereof must be based on Section 31(a) of DILG-COMELEC-NYC Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2017-1, and the process of said removal must conform to Sections 32, 33, 35 and 36 of the same JMC. In case penalty of removal from office has been imposed, it shall be considered a bar to the candidacy of the respondent to any elective SK office. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted Very truly rs, of the Secretary: rdingly. Thank you.
